x-reconnect.duplicate_rule: drop events with event_id already observed by the client
x-reconnect.ordering: sequence_number is monotonic inside one WebSocket subscription

get.summary: Upgrade client connection to C7 WebSocket event stream

parameters.name: last_event_id
parameters.description: Last C7 event observed by the client. Used to resume without redelivering already observed events.

parameters.name: after_sequence_number
parameters.description: Fallback resume cursor for clients that know the last observed sequence number.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: Tenant scope for routed C7 delivery.

parameters.name: conversation_id
parameters.description: Conversation scope for client-side realtime subscriptions.

parameters.name: endpoint_id
parameters.description: Communication endpoint scope for client-side realtime subscriptions.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Client profile scope for manager workspace realtime subscriptions.

parameters.name: recipient_user_id
parameters.description: Notification recipient scope for user-facing realtime subscriptions.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: User scope for manager/admin realtime subscriptions.

parameters.name: manager_user_id
parameters.description: Manager-specific scope for routed realtime subscriptions.

parameters.name: visitor_session_id
parameters.description: Optional Web Chat visitor session scope. Events without this field may still be routed by organization/conversation filters.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade accepted. Text frames contain C7.WebSocketEvent JSON envelopes.

426.description: Upgrade Required when called as a regular HTTP request.
